{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jedi flash code''' was a method of communication that relied on irregular noises. It was used by the [[New Jedi Order]], and in [[44 ABY]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sent a secret message to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by tapping in [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] flash code on the [[Comm unit/Legends|mike]] of the navigator's station on the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Emiax]]''.
